claim: Patchline ships an instrumental-variable estimate of gating's incident effect robust to unmeasured confounding. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the instrumental-variable claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make instrumental-variable-estimate-gate`.
